frozen_actual_source_binding_gate.note: CORRECTION_02. The ACTUAL resolved filesystem source of each input must equal its frozen expectation, independently of the identity strings stored inside the databases. No production parameter can substitute any of them. CORRECTION_03: a refused invocation does not resolve these paths at all.

output_sink_safety.note: CORRECTION_02. The default result destination is a unique OS-temp file, never $PSScriptRoot. Every requested destination is normalized, link-resolved through its nearest existing parent, and rejected if it lands under a protected root or aliases a protected input. An unsafe sink receives zero bytes, yields a complete V2 failure JSON on stdout, exits non-zero, and emits no production PASS marker.

exclusive_result_creation.note: CORRECTION_03. The result file is created with one atomic create-if-absent open (open(path, "x") = O_CREAT|O_EXCL / CREATE_NEW). Any object already at the pathname -- ordinary file, NTFS hard link to any file object, or an object a racing process created after the path checks -- makes creation fail before any byte is written; that object is never truncated, replaced, renamed, unlinked, or re-created. The default OS-temp destination uses the same primitive. No retry.
exclusive_result_creation.on_failure: output_sink.output_written=false; complete V2 failure JSON on stdout; non-zero exit; no production PASS marker; no retry
exclusive_result_creation.wrapper_post_probe_report: result byte length and SHA-256 are reported only when the probe reports output_written=true; the requested pathname is never stat-ed or read otherwise

mutation_proof.note: CORRECTION_02. For every store whose pre-read proof succeeded, the post-read proof is attempted in a finally-equivalent path after the SQLite connections are closed, on successful runs and on readable failing runs alike. An unobtainable post-proof is classified POST_READ_PROOF_UNOBTAINABLE:<store> and fails closed; a store that was never readable keeps explicit nulls rather than a fabricated proof.

mandatory_observation_validator.note: CORRECTION_02. validate_mandatory_observations() runs last, over the fully assembled result, and emits MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD:<dotted.path> for any mandatory observation that is absent or nulled.
